item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00052","decision":"none","candidate_ranking":["C08","C18","C21"],"selected_candidate_label":null,"confidence":0.93,"relationship_type":"none","rationale":"No displayed candidate plausibly supplied a concrete and material drafting template for the later order. C08 is closest because it uses Civil Service Commission-centered, agency-wide recordkeeping machinery, including a centrally maintained index and agency duties to furnish employee information, but its security-investigation system does not parallel the Official Personnel Folder regime or the later order's operative sequence. C18 contains a somewhat similar definition of “agency” and delegates regulatory authority, while C21 assigns the Commission authority to prescribe personnel regulations; these are isolated, conventional administrative features rather than material template evidence. The child expressly revokes a September 25, 1946 records order, suggesting a more direct antecedent that is not among the displayed candidates.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"Each such folder shall be under the jurisdiction and control, and shall be a part of the records, of the United States Civil Service Commission","parent_excerpt":"There shall be established and maintained in the Civil Service Commission a security-investigations index","explanation":"C08 and the child both centralize employee-related records in the Civil Service Commission, but the records, purposes, and operative systems differ materially."},{"child_excerpt":"the term “agency” shall mean any executive department or independent establishment of the Federal Government, including a corporation wholly owned or controlled by the United States","parent_excerpt":"The term “agency” means each department, commission, authority, administration, board, or other independent establishment of the Government of the United States, including any wholly-owned instrumentality of the United States","explanation":"C18 has a similar government-wide agency definition, but such definitional language alone is insufficient to establish a drafting-template relationship."},{"child_excerpt":"The Commission is hereby authorized to prescribe regulations, not inconsistent with this order","parent_excerpt":"The Civil Service Commission is authorized to prescribe regulations and procedures, in addition to those otherwise authorized herein","explanation":"C21 shares a conventional delegation of personnel-related rulemaking to the Commission, without the child's folder-establishment, content, maintenance, and transfer machinery."}]}
